settings_help.source: (bool) - Keep the run's working masks/ folders after every field is merged. Off by default: they are removed once each field is committed to fov.ome.zarr (or merged/ for 'npy' runs), which holds the channels and every mask. With fov.ome.zarr no stack/ or masks/ folder is written: the channels and every stage's masks go straight into the field (the run's small records to fov.ome.zarr/.spacr_mask_run); kept, those labels are reused by a rerun, otherwise a rerun segments again. Older projects' stack/ folders are still read, and kept or removed by this setting as before.
